start.description: Shell command that boots the isolated demo (e.g. `make demo`).

url.description: Loopback URL the demo serves on.

readyOutput.description: Regex to wait for in the start command's output.

env.description: Extra environment for the start command (e.g. DEMO_NOW).

baseDeps.description: Untracked dependency folders symlinked into the base worktree of a visual check (e.g. .venv, frontend/node_modules).

cacheKeyFiles.description: Files of the repo (lockfiles, e.g. requirements.txt) whose content is part of the base capture's cache key: the base runs against the working tree's baseDeps, so a change to what they were built from must not reuse an old base.

clock.description: Fixed browser time (Date.now / new Date). Pair it with the demo's own DEMO_NOW.

storageState.description: Path (relative to the repo) of a logged-in Playwright storage state.

mask.description: Selectors painted over in every shot (timestamps, avatars, anything volatile).

viewports.description: Overrides or adds to the profile's viewports, by name.

path.description: Path on the demo; // and /\ would leave it.

tags.description: Which workflows include the scene. Default: check and audit.

viewports.description: Limit the scene to these viewport names.

schemes.description: Limit the scene to these colour schemes.

settle.description: Selector to wait for (or ms) after the steps, before the shot.

target.description: Selector: shoot this element (plus padding) instead of the page.

fullPage.description: Default: true for check and audit, false for presentation.

spotlight.description: Selector kept bright while the rest of the page is dimmed (a transparent overlay over its box, so the element is not repositioned).

css.description: Arbitrary CSS injected before the shot.

stills.description: false renders only the loop: needs `loop` and the `presentation` tag, and renders no stills for any viewport or scheme.

loop.description: Record the steps as a silent loop (webm + mp4 + jpg poster) for the landing and README profiles.
